title: ReleaseLinkGate v1
description: External reference release policy. emitted_URL must be in observed_URLs set. Every external URL in any artifact, reply, or packet must satisfy Release(Link,Claim) = Observed ∧ Reachable ∧ IdentityMatch ∧ Supports. RegionMatch is mandatory for App Store / Play Store / geo-dependent sources (enforced via JSON Schema if/then on expected_entity.kind). Status ladder: UNOBSERVED → OBSERVED+DEAD → OBSERVED+WRONG_ENTITY → CORRECT+CANDIDATE → CORRECT+SUPPORTED. See AAA-IR/MIGRATION.md law 9.

canonical_url.description: URL after redirect-following (the actual canonical resource). May differ from `url`.

claim.description: What the link is being used to support.

expected_entity.description: What the link is supposed to point to.

region.description: ISO 3166 or vendor region. MANDATORY for region-dependent kinds.

observed.description: URL was observed in tool evidence (retrieved, fetched, searched).

reachable.description: Live probe returned 2xx or canonical redirect.

region_match.description: Region of URL matches expected_entity.region. Mandatory for app/paper kind.

supports_claim.description: Page content supports the claim being made (can be minimal if claim is just 'the link').

release_decision.description: RELEASE = all four checks pass. SUPPRESS = dead/unreachable. REJECT = wrong entity or unsupported claim.

retrieval_response_status.description: HTTP status code returned by the URL probe.

content_source_identity_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical content (after redirect + normalization). Allows evidence that two releases cite identical content.

verifier_identity.description: Who vouched for the gate decision.

observed_at.description: When the URL was first observed in tool evidence.

verified_at.description: When the gate was last re-verified. Null if single-shot verification.

evidence_refs.description: Probe / fetch / search results backing the decision.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT 1: Region-dependent sources MUST carry region_match verdict. App Store / Play Store / paper repository kinds cannot be RELEASED with region_match=null.

region_match.description: Mandatory for app/paper kinds. Null forbidden.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT 2: RELEASE requires all checks pass.
HARD INVARIANT 3: status ladder is monotonic. UNOBSERVED < OBSERVED_DEAD < OBSERVED_WRONG_ENTITY < CANDIDATE < SUPPORTED. SUPPRESS forbidden for status=SUPPORTED.
